note: FINE-TUNED proposal head (the first trained head on this track): multi-step chained + top-8 soft-label distillation of the pinned bf16 head on 1.2M teacher-forced tokens, then a 0.5 weight-space soup with the pinned head to preserve its copy behavior, quantized affine-4/group-64 to the backbone geometry. The promoted affine-2 compact draft readout is inherited tensor-for-tensor (it derives from the backbone lm_head, not the head), and the precision islands are regenerated as this head's OWN bf16 rows at the inherited indices. The head only proposes: target forward, exact top-2, emitted-token decision, journal, rollback and serial replay are unchanged. Immutable-revision, single-file tree digest, no remote code.
